name: iSeller
description_en:
iSeller is an omnichannel commerce and POS platform with a cloud backend for products, orders, inventory, customers and reporting. It serves retail and food/service workflows through POS applications, an online store and connected channels.

Its terminology separates stores, outlets and registers. A merchant can share a catalogue while maintaining inventory per outlet; extra registers and hardware can affect the commercial scope. A free admin-app download does not mean the hosted business service is free.
description_zh:
iSeller 是全渠道电商及 POS 平台，以云后端管理商品、订单、库存、客户及报表，通过 POS 应用、网店和连接渠道服务零售、餐饮及服务流程。

产品区分商店、网点和收银终端。商家可共享商品目录，同时按网点管理库存；额外终端及硬件影响商业范围。管理应用免费下载，不代表托管业务服务免费。

core_features.explanation_en: Maintain product stock levels separately for each outlet.
core_features.explanation_zh: 为各网点分别维护商品库存。

core_features.explanation_en: Track variant SKUs and deduct component stock when a bundle sells.
core_features.explanation_zh: 跟踪规格 SKU，套装销售时扣减组件库存。

core_features.explanation_en: Use retail/F&B POS, online store and other channels around one backend.
core_features.explanation_zh: 以统一后端支持零售餐饮 POS、网店及其他渠道。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Track a bundle sale at the correct outlet
sections.title_zh: 在正确网点跟踪套装销售
sections.en: A retailer could define variant SKUs, assign opening stock per outlet and sell a bundle containing standard products. The feature page says bundle sales deduct the contained products’ stock. Evaluate a sale, cancellation and inter-outlet stock change before migration. Confirm whether online fulfilment draws from a selected outlet or another stock rule; the general omnichannel claim does not settle that configuration.
sections.zh: 零售商可定义规格 SKU、按网点设置期初库存，并销售由标准商品组成的套装。功能页说明套装销售会扣减组件库存。迁移前应评估销售、取消及跨网点库存变化。应确认网店履约取哪个网点库存或采用何种规则，通用全渠道宣传不能确定具体配置。

sections.title_en: Offline POS does not imply offline cloud administration
sections.title_zh: 离线 POS 不代表云后台也可离线
sections.en: The pricing page describes SmartSync allowing work online or offline and syncing when connectivity returns. The feature page identifies a cloud backend and multiple POS channels. Test the operations permitted offline, delayed synchronization and two registers selling the same stock; no conflict-resolution or payment-offline guarantee was verified. Prepare devices, barcode/receipt peripherals, product IDs and network ownership.
sections.zh: 定价页介绍 SmartSync 可在线或离线工作，恢复连接后同步；功能页明确有云后端及多个 POS 渠道。应测试离线允许的操作、延迟同步及两个终端销售同一库存的情况。本文未核实冲突解决或支付离线保证。应准备设备、条码收据外设、商品标识及网络负责人。

sections.title_en: Quote business size, outlets, registers and payment costs
sections.title_zh: 按业务规模、网点、终端及支付费用询价
sections.en: The page says plans share core features and are sized by business scale, with extra-register charges. However, retrieved plan names, amounts, limits and payment rates remain unrendered template placeholders. No numeric plan price is therefore recorded. Hardware and app add-ons appear separately. The page’s no-platform-transaction-fee language should not be read as free payment processing; request the active country, devices, registers, add-ons and processor terms in a quote.
sections.zh: 页面说明核心功能相同，按业务规模分套餐，并有额外终端费。但读取的套餐名称、金额、上限及支付费率仍是未渲染模板变量，因此不记录数字套餐价。硬件及应用附加项另列。“不收平台交易费”也不能理解为支付处理免费，应按实际国家、设备、终端、附加项及支付条款询价。

sections.title_en: Start with a catalogue that can be reconciled
sections.title_zh: 先准备可核对的商品目录
sections.en: The feature page supports CSV product import/export, variants with their own SKU/weight/price/stock, and per-outlet stock administration. Use a small controlled import before moving a live catalogue. Product export does not establish portability of every order, payment or configuration record. The page also names native payment and API options; their eligibility and exact connector rights require confirmation.
sections.zh: 功能页支持商品 CSV 导入导出，以及独立 SKU、重量、价格、库存的规格和按网点库存管理。迁移正式目录前应先进行小型受控导入。能导出商品，不证明所有订单、支付和配置都可迁移。页面还列有原生支付及 API，但其准入和具体连接器权益需确认。

sections.title_en: Evaluate as an outlet-based selling system
sections.en: Retailers and food/service operators combining physical and online sales have a relevant use case. A digital-only subscription product may not need registers and outlet inventory. No production POS, card transaction, synchronization recovery, open-source licence or self-hosted backend was tested or verified. Chinese editorial copy is not evidence of a Chinese POS interface.
sections.zh: 结合门店及线上销售的零售餐饮服务商有相关场景。纯数字订阅产品可能无需终端和网点库存。本文未测试或核实生产 POS、银行卡交易、同步恢复、开源许可或自托管后端。中文介绍不证明 POS 有中文界面。
